I’ll simplify the sign-in loading state, keep the chat introduction visible until an idea is sent, and fix the question title’s blue focus outline. I’m using UI Craft and will check desktop and mobile.

The chat heading is explicitly dismissed on every keystroke, and the question title is automatically focused when it appears. I’ll tie the heading to submission and keep focus off the question title. The sign-in callback will use the Google button and spinner for its normal loading state.

Yes—all three fixes are done:

- Sign-in loading shows the Google button with a spinner.
- Chat title and description stay while typing and disappear on Enter or send.
- Question titles no longer receive automatic focus or the blue outline.

Desktop/mobile regression checks, all 104 unit tests, and the build pass. The broader browser suite has older failing expectations.
I’ll commit the fixes and push the current branch.
